svg.title: A cutscene runs from top to bottom
svg.desc: At the top, the scene as the game plays it, each message answered: the view shakes, she cries out, turns to Isaac and speaks again. Below, the script a woman in Vale runs when Isaac talks to her after Kalay, one step to a line with how long each step holds the scene. The player loses control. The view starts to shake, and the script waits ten frames. The shake is set to die away. She says "Aghh! I felt another one!", which holds until the player answers it and then twenty frames more. She turns to face Isaac and the scene holds twenty frames. She says the next line, which holds until the player answers it. Then the player has control again. Steps that take no time follow each other within one frame; steps that take time wait inside themselves, so the script reads as a list of what happens, in order.
svg.text: A WOMAN IN VALE FEELS ANOTHER TREMOR

g.text: "They've been going on for a while..."
Each step that takes time waits inside itself,
so the script is a plain list of what happens,
and the walk resumes only after the last line.
